content.text:
Repaired and resubmitted.

**What changed in response to the verifier:** the super-cap base in new Section 12.1.3 no longer keys off the narrow "Approval Payments" category. It now reads "three times the aggregate amounts paid or payable by PB to SFJ under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the Claim, and in no event less than three times the aggregate amounts payable by PB to SFJ under this Agreement in the first twelve (12) months in which such amounts become due" — comprehensive annual amounts payable, with a floor so the cap cannot be zero for Claims arising before any payment falls due, and still scoped only to 12.1.3 so SFJ's existing uncapped indemnities in 12.1.1 are untouched.

The other two operations are unchanged and re-validated (ok:true, minimality ok): 12.1.2(f) narrowed from "either Party" to "PB", and the one-token 12.2.1 cross-reference conform. All seven fallback elements are now mapped to the inserted operative language.
